name: Conversational Service AI
short: Guided conversations for coverage, service and employee knowledge.
problem: Broad questions and one-off answers leave people searching for the next step.
role: Sole product manager, owning discovery, customer collaboration, requirements, development coordination and rollout.
vision: Help people reach a useful, contextual answer through a guided conversation.
kpis: Target: 10% lower handling time · Cost per resolution · Handoffs
outcome: Product scope: intent recognition, clarification, grounded answers and relevant follow-ups. Savings remain targets.
details: Recognize a clear question, a broad request or an opening greeting, while retaining the conversation context.
Use concise clarification choices to narrow the topic before presenting a detailed answer.
Provide a focused answer grounded in authorized policy or knowledge content, with a path to the relevant source.
Offer relevant follow-up questions, or guide the person to an appropriate service route when more support is needed.

name: Digital Underwriting
short: Green-path screening and source-linked medical profiles.
problem: Routine referrals and fragmented medical information increase manual underwriting work.
role: Sole product manager across discovery, requirements, customers, development coordination, integrations and rollout.
vision: Two connected capabilities: consistent eligibility screening and a traceable medical workspace for expert review.
kpis: Target: ~40% less manual effort · Green-path rate · Quality
outcome: Product scope: screening, medical profiles, missing-information review and decision support. The ~40% effort reduction remains a target.
details: Use a defined eligibility check to distinguish routine applications from those needing expert attention. An unfamiliar or incomplete case follows the review route.
Check document relevance, duplication and readability; organize findings into diagnoses, linked events and a medical timeline with source references.
Identify missing supporting information and prepare relevant measurements for underwriting tools. Allow authorized reviewers to validate, edit and provide feedback.
Eligible routine cases can follow a green path subject to the required checks. Exceptions and unresolved information are routed to an underwriter with context.

name: Claims Decision Support
short: Medical and legal evidence for better-informed case assessment.
problem: Claims handlers reconstruct complex medical and legal histories before assessing the case.
role: Sole product manager, owning business discovery, customer needs, product definition, development coordination and rollout.
vision: A consistent evidence-led workspace, from case understanding to informed professional assessment.
kpis: Target: 20% less preparation & review effort · Source completeness
outcome: Product scope: structured case summaries, evidence review and a roadmap for decision support. The 20% effort reduction remains a target.
details: Bring the relevant medical records, expert opinions and legal materials into one case view, keeping the source of each finding visible.
Prepare a consistent medical and case summary that helps a claims handler understand the history without repeatedly rebuilding the file.
Highlight information requiring attention and support comparison with relevant professional knowledge and historical cases.
Connect the case brief to professional assessment and the decision-support roadmap. Recommendations require validation; the claims professional retains the decision.
